overview: The Anna Callahan for State Representative campaign held a virtual updates meeting to review campaign operations, fundraising, and voter outreach strategy seven weeks ahead of the 34th District primary. Campaign staff and supporters discussed field tactics, COVID-19 safety measures for door knocking, and plans for mail-in ballot education.

items.title: Campaign Overview and Team Introductions
items.summary: Campaign Manager Caitlin outlined the meeting structure and seven-week primary timeline, followed by introductions from kitchen cabinet members and campaign volunteers.

items.title: Candidate Platform and Pitch Update
items.summary: Candidate Anna Callahan described her door-to-door voter pitch focused on State House transparency, reform of the Speaker of the House's power, and progressive co-governance.

items.title: Supporter Endorsements and Remarks
items.summary: Campaign supporters Greg Nadeau and former gubernatorial candidate Bob Massie spoke about their decisions to back Callahan over the incumbent, citing the need for State House structural reform.

items.title: Fundraising and Field Operations Report
items.summary: Field staff reported on June fundraising progress, COVID-19 safety protocols for door knocking, phone banking schedules, and relational organizing through the Reach application.

items.title: Strategy Discussion and Mail-In Voting Q&A
items.summary: Attendees exchanged voter contact advice, video media ideas, and tactics for assisting district residents with mail-in ballot registration.
